Abstract:
Matrix Widgets have been part of the Matrix universe for years — But:
What is a Widget? What is its definition, taxonomy and specification? 
Why Widgets makes sense in times of AI? 
Why Widgets make sense while matrix is getting more complicated on the client side?
The newly founded Matrix Widgets Working Group of the Foundation is tackling this: aligning on definitions, mapping use cases, and building the foundation for a flourishing widget and app ecosystem across all Matrix clients. 
In this talk we share the Working Group's goals, current status, and latest results — and invite anybody to get involved.
